name: P-009 / R-17 live sync-batch slot accounting on the operator database (green-main-ratchet-convergence-2026-10-17, rubric rev 12)
summary: The R-17 probe (rubric rev 12 check, docs/evidence/p009-r17-slot-accounting-live-2026-10-20/probe.sql) read harness_shared.routines coverage records for sync-batch-delta-check and sync-batch-lint-guards plus their coverage-low alarm work-items, and returned 2|291|0.044673539518900345|0|0|1. The committed oracle judged it PASS: both routines present, every slot accounted, the slot floor met, and low coverage carrying a fresh open alarm. All four negative controls failed as required. Coverage itself is about 4.5% of slots judged; the 95% target was rescoped out by owner choice (#D-036) and is not claimed here.

assertions.evidence: alarm_open forced false: low coverage without an alarm must fail; row 2|291|0.044673539518900345|0|1|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: low-coverage-has-fresh-alarm
alarm freshness window moved into the future: a stale alarm must not count (H2); row 2|291|0.044673539518900345|0|1|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: low-coverage-has-fresh-alarm
only terminal alarm rows match: a closed alarm must not count; row 2|291|0.044673539518900345|0|1|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: low-coverage-has-fresh-alarm
slot floor raised to 300 above the live 24h count: the probe must stop reporting accounted; row 2|291|0.044673539518900345|0|0|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: probe-verdict-agrees

limitations: This is one live reading of a rolling 24h window, not a continuous 24h observation; the routine keeps recording, so a later reading can differ.
The probe judges the recorded slot causes, not whether each recorded cause is true; cause correctness is covered by the tree evidence bound to AUTO-BAR-R-8-P-009 and SPEC-P-009.

instrument.role: Every pass/fail decision on the probe rows is taken by this committed oracle; run.mjs only executes the SQL and records output.
